name: Afro house DJ for an after-party: live DJ set
seoTitle: Afro house DJ for an after-party: live DJ set
description: Here’s the DJ playing a live outdoor set. The DJ plays Afro house, deep house, amapiano, techno and electronic music, and can play live tabla on request.
more: The DJ trained in Indian classical music on the tabla, a pair of hand drums, and has played Denver's house clubs and club nights in Chicago, San Francisco, San Diego and Hong Kong. You can ask for a relaxed warm-up set, a high-energy set, or one long set that builds from one to the other.
